items.title: Client Platform Engineer
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI’s Client Platform Engineering team builds and operates the platforms that make employee devices secure, reliable, and easy to use. Our work spans device posture and trust, onboarding, application delivery, operating-system updates, fleet telemetry, and employee-facing remediation. We partner with Security, IT, Research, Applied, and specialized engineering teams to reduce friction while protecting OpenAI’s systems and data. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Client Platform Engineer, You will build and own agentic solutions that automate OAI fleet operations and reduce employee friction, with measurable outcomes and reliability. You will develop first-party software, integrate commercial and open-source tools, and own changes from design and testing through deployment and production operations. Your work will improve security, reliability, and the employee experience. We’re looking for people who are passionate about automation, endpoint security, and building scalable solutions that improve employee experience. You should have deep experience securing and managing Linux fleets at scale, with strong software engineering skills to automate security controls and fleet operations across environments with different compliance requirements. Your problem-solving mindset and attention to detail will be key to success in this role. In this role, you will: Build the platforms that help employees do their best work on devices they can trust. - Own the design, development, deployment, and operation of secure Linux endpoint management systems across environments with different compliance requirements. - Create magical employee experiences by building agentic workflows with OpenAI products and models that use fleet telemetry to anticipate issues, guide remediation, and design friction out of everyday work. - Make new hires productive from day one, using OpenAI products to simplify device setup, software delivery, and onboarding support. - Build secure, reliable workflows with scoped access, human review for sensitive changes, traceable actions, and tested recovery. - Partner with IT, Security, Research, and Engineering to deliver consistent Linux provisioning, updates, and support alongside macOS and Windows. - Develop first-party software and integrate commercial and open-source tools for software packaging, deployment, and application management. - Manage fleet configuration as code through GitOps, version control, peer review, and automated validation. - Build and operate CI/CD pipelines for fleet infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and GCP, with staged deployments and tested rollback. - Use fleet telemetry to proactively improve performance and reliability, detect configuration drift, and verify deployment outcomes. - Participate in engineering on-call, own incident resolution, and turn operational lessons into lasting improvements that reduce recurring failures and manual work. YOU MAY BE A FIT FOR THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE: - Proficiency in Python, Go, or another modern programming language. - Deep experience securing and managing Linux fleets with configuration management, MDM, device enrollment, policy enforcement, and cloud identity integration. - Demonstrated success with open-source endpoint tools for configuration, device and application management, and telemetry. - Experience delivering secure, reliable, scalable systems across different compliance requirements. - Deep experience managing infrastructure at scale with IaC and GitOps, using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, and Chef. - Experience integrating and operating fleet infrastructure with CI/CD and DevOps workflows. - A track record of deploying and operating fleet infrastructure in public cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP). - Initiative, analytical judgment, and the ability to turn problems into practical improvements. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE: - Deep experience with open-source fleet management tools and frameworks. - Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. - Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, and NIST. - Strong soft skills, including stakeholder communication and cross-functional collaboration. - Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, CCSP. - A security thought leader with contributions to CPE open-source projects or technical communities. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. items.title: Enterprise Security Engineer, Vulnerability Management
items.description: About the Team Enterprise Security protects the systems, identities, devices, and services that enable OpenAI's employees to work securely and effectively. We partner across IT and Security to understand risk, build practical defenses, and support a rapidly evolving technical environment. About the Role We are looking for an Enterprise Security Engineer with a focus on vulnerability management, novel vulnerabilities, and zero-day response. You will investigate vulnerabilities and security weaknesses across networks, endpoints, and SaaS, prioritize them in the context of real exposure, and drive remediation through verified outcomes. You will also build security capabilities and automation, use AI agents to solve practical problems, and help shape how enterprise security operates as agents become a larger part of everyday work. This role is open to candidates in San Francisco, CA, and to remote candidates in the United States. In this role, you will: - Discover, investigate, and prioritize vulnerabilities and misconfigurations across enterprise systems, including novel vulnerabilities and zero-days with incomplete information and no established playbook. - Translate technical findings into clear attack paths, business impact, and actionable remediation. - Develop and validate emergency mitigations when patches are unavailable, coordinate with system owners, vendors, and incident responders, and drive durable fixes through verified closure. - Improve asset visibility, ownership, vulnerability data quality, and reporting. - Build and operate security tools and integrations using code, APIs, automation, and AI agents. - Design controls for agent access, execution, and accountability. - Contribute across endpoint, network, identity, and SaaS security, and support incident investigations when needed. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have independently investigated novel or emerging vulnerabilities and driven enterprise remediation from uncertain initial reports through mitigation and verified closure. - Bring technical depth in a relevant security domain and working knowledge across networks, endpoints, and SaaS. - Can understand and improve code and safely integrate APIs and security systems. - Have solved substantive problems using AI agents and can explain how you evaluated and corrected their work. - Think clearly about security tradeoffs, ambiguous evidence, and the changing risks of agentic systems. - Collaborate effectively, take ownership, and communicate technical risk to varied audiences. items.title: Director, Infrastructure Lease Accounting
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is seeking a Director, Infrastructure Lease Accounting to lead technical accounting for our most complex infrastructure and energy arrangements — the data center leases and related structures underpinning our recently significant investment in American computing infrastructure. As we continue our rapid growth, you will ensure the financial statement accuracy of the most technically complex contracts we enter into. This is an opportunity to be at the heart of one of the fastest-scaling companies in the industry, and to shape how Anthropic accounts for the highest-stakes arrangements underpinning our compute and energy portfolio. You will serve as the technical accounting subject matter expert for arrangements spanning data center leases (ASC 842), and counterparty or joint-venture structures (ASC 810 VIE analysis). You'll work closely with Real Estate, Legal, Finance, and external auditors to ensure accounting implications are understood before commitments are made. Responsibilities Serve as the technical accounting subject matter expert for Anthropic's most complex infrastructure arrangements, leading classification, measurement, and subsequent accounting judgments Apply ASC 842 to complex lease arrangements, including lease identification, modifications, reassessments, and embedded leases within compute, colocation, and data center contracts Apply ASC 810 to counterparty and joint-venture structures, including variable interest entity (VIE) analysis for special purpose entities Apply ASC 815 to energy and infrastructure arrangements, including consideration of embedded derivatives Lead technical accounting analysis and memo preparation for new arrangements, ensuring positions are well-reasoned, supported, and auditor-ready Partner with Real Estate, Legal, and Finance teams during contract negotiation and execution to ensure accounting implications are understood before commitments are made Serve as a trusted finance partner to non-finance stakeholders — explaining the financial statement impact of their decisions in clear, simple terms they can act on Serve as a key point of contact with external auditors on technical accounting matters within your portfolio Mentor accounting professionals across the Infrastructure Accounting team on technical accounting matters Drive process improvements and automation, including leveraging AI tooling, to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of technical accounting work Minimum qualifications Have 12+ years of progressive experience in accounting, with meaningful time in a technical accounting role Hold a Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA required Possess strong technical accounting knowledge of ASC 842 (leases), ASC 810 (consolidation, including VIE analysis), and ASC 815 (derivatives and hedging), applied to real arrangements Have a track record of authoring and defending technical accounting memos on complex, judgment-intensive arrangements Demonstrate strong analytical abilities and comfort working with large, complex contracts and datasets Have a track record of improving scalable technical accounting processes in fast-moving environments Are adept at translating technical accounting concepts into financial implications for non-finance stakeholders Communicate clearly and influence effectively across cross-functional partners — Real Estate, Legal, Finance, and Procurement Have experience partnering with engineering, infrastructure, or operations teams to improve financial reporting and cost transparency Preferred qualifications Background in a Big 4 technical accounting practice (SEC reporting / technical consultation) combined with industry experience Experience at hyperscalers, utilities, or energy companies with meaningful PPA, REC, or commodity-arrangement exposure Experience with renewable energy contracts, carbon markets, or related clean-energy accounting frameworks Exposure to data center and compute-related infrastructure arrangements (including colocation, dark fiber IRUs, and equipment leases) Experience with lease accounting software and derivative / hedge accounting systems at scale SQL proficiency for querying and analyzing large contract and accounting datasets Knowledge of AI/ML infrastructure and associated cost structures Experience applying AI tooling (including Claude) to technical accounting research, memo drafting, or close automation Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and drive results in rapidly changing environments The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $230,000 — $300,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

You will define the marketplace product strategy and translate it into a clear roadmap, scalable tooling, and an operating model through which customers can discover, evaluate, purchase, deploy, and manage trusted third-party solutions built on and with OpenAI’s models. You are a senior marketplace builder with strong product judgment, operational rigor, and a track record of developing B2B platforms at scale. You are comfortable moving between product strategy, marketplace operations, commercial models, data, and systems design. You can turn ambiguous customer and partner needs into clear priorities and build the infrastructure required to support a trusted, high-quality marketplace. items.title: Compliance Analyst
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? We’re looking for a Compliance Analyst, at Easygo - a crew surpassing 1,500 globally, powering Stake and KICK, two of the world’s largest online entertainment and livestreaming platforms. Join the team keeping Stake on the right side of regulation. Support day-to-day compliance operations and help the business balance regulatory obligations with commercial priorities across multiple jurisdictions. Crypto is a big part of the picture, so a solid grasp of it from an AML angle will take you a long way. If you’re comfortable with ambiguity and keen to find smarter ways of working, we want to hear from you. What you’ll build with us: Expect variety, and plenty of it. Days blend hands-on casework, like transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, risk reviews and compliance queries, with project work across the platforms. Dig into governance, policies and procedures, spot gaps and partner with the product and BI teams to close them. Collaborate across teams and time zones, and enjoy the pace as priorities shift and projects evolve. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity at our Melbourne office. You’ll work right where it all happens, surrounded by our fearless crew shipping high-impact work. Who is Easygo? We’re a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that’s where the real fun happens. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify , Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Review customer accounts and transaction activity, escalating concerns where needed Follow assigned cases through to completion, monitoring compliance channels and responding to queries Assist with data privacy and law enforcement enquiries Contribute to regulatory gap analyses and keep Stake’s obligation and risk registers accurate and current Help draft and maintain policies, procedures and compliance records Track AML/CTF, sanctions and crypto-asset regulation, and communicate the impact to the business Support compliance projects and suggest practical process improvements, working with internal and external stakeholders Your track record: 3+ years in an AML, financial crime or online gaming compliance role Working knowledge of AML/CTF obligations, sanctions regimes and KYC/EDD requirements Familiarity with blockchain analytics platforms and comfort reading on-chain transaction data, plus a grasp of crypto from an AML lens Experience using AI tools and agentic workflows to improve compliance processes Confidence working with data, including spreadsheets, queries and reporting Strong written English, with the ability to document decisions and investigations clearly and defensibly Detail oriented and organised, able to manage competing BAU tasks and projects and see them through to completion with minimal supervision Bonus points if you also have: Scripting or automation experience A tertiary qualification in law, business, finance or a related field, or an equivalent compliance certification Benefits that give you the Easygo Edge, so you can build the future of fearless tech with us: Disrupt: we push boundaries and play to win Ballots for major sporting and music events Time with our partners and ambassadors, and exclusive office sessions with leading streamers, creators and industry guests Spin the Wheel Fridays on your birthday and work anniversary, with prizes up to $1,000 or a car EV subscriptions, novated leasing, energy savings through Origin, and everyday discounts and cash back through Paylab Rewards Evolve: we’re in constant motion, personally and professionally The ultimate sandbox: 1 in 3 of our people level up their role every year. If you deliver, you move. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

items.title: Applied AI Engineer, Startups
items.description: About the Team The Applied AI Engineering team is responsible for ensuring the safe and effective deployment of Generative AI applications for developers and startups. We act as a trusted advisor and thought partner for our customers, working to build an effective backlog of GenAI use cases for their industry and drive them to production through strong technical guidance. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to late-stage startups. About the Role We are seeking a technically proficient, business-minded Applied AI Engineer to help push the frontier of advanced AI with our strategic startup customers. You'll work with some of the most exciting AI startups in the world, guiding them through ideation, development, delivery, and scaling to accelerate and maximize the value of what they build on our platform. You will have the opportunity to work on the most novel and creative use cases being built on our API, serving as a critical partner in collecting and delivering high-fidelity product and model feedback internally. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Applied Research, and Product teams, and you will report to the Startups AI Deployment Lead. This role is based in our Sao Paolo, Brazil office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. items.title: Research Engineer, GPU Performance
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Research Engineer, GPU performance, you will sit at the heart of that spectrum: your low-level work directly determines how fast our frontier models can be trained and served. Working hand-in-hand with Research Scientists, you'll make every GPU count. Mistral AI is hiring an expert in pushing large language model's GPU utilization and performance to their limits.. In this role, you will own the performance of our models end-to-end: writing the low-level code that extracts the maximum capacity from high-end hardware, and rethinking model architectures so they run efficiently at scale. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Develop low-level code that takes full advantage of high-end GPUs and maxes out their capacity — from custom kernels to memory-layout and communication optimisations. - Rethink parts of the generative model architecture to make them more suitable for efficient inference, in collaboration with Research Scientists. - Integrate low-level efficient code into a high-level MLOps framework, so that optimisations benefit every training run and deployment rather than a single experiment. - Profile, benchmark and squeeze performance out of large-scale training and inference on thousands of GPUs. - Model LLM execution on various GPUs with high fidelity to assess hardware usage and build serving performance estimates. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - High technical competence for writing custom low-level kernels and pushing GPUs to their limits. - High expertise in the distributed computation infrastructure of current-generation GPU clusters. - Overall understanding of the field of generative AI; knowledge of, or interest in, fine-tuning and using language models for applications. - Strong software-design instincts: testing, code review, CI/CD. - Self-starter, low-ego, collaborative. items.title: SoC Engineer
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops custom silicon and systems for advanced AI workloads. Our first-party accelerator team works across chip architecture, design, software, and systems to build the computing platforms that power frontier models. We are a small, dynamic team that values technical breadth, hands-on engineering, and creative approaches to building complex hardware. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a SoC Engineer to help architect, design, and integrate OpenAI’s first-party AI accelerators. You will build the processor, interconnect, I/O, and platform infrastructure that connects our accelerator designs into complete, functional systems. This role combines architectural judgment with hands-on implementation. You’ll work closely with design, architecture, verification, and software teams throughout development, from defining subsystem requirements and integrating IP to pre-silicon validation, silicon bring-up, and post-silicon debug. You should enjoy stretching across domains, rolling up your sleeves, and doing the work needed to make a complex system function end to end. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Define and implement SoC architectures spanning embedded processors, AMBA interconnects, peripheral subsystems, PCI Express, Ethernet and die-to-die interfaces. - Develop the microarchitecture and RTL design of subsystems supporting I/O and SoC functionality. - Integrate Arm Cortex-M and Cortex-A processors, AXI/APB fabrics, and third-party controller IP, including the RTL and glue logic needed to connect these components. - Develop reset and boot architectures, working with firmware and software teams to define sequencing, initialization, and survivability behavior. - Incorporate debug, test, and security requirements into the SoC architecture and implementation, partnering with other silicon designers to make the silicon observable, testable, and secure. - Drive PCIe and other I/O integration, including controller and PHY interfaces, high-speed SerDes, and die-to-die connectivity. - Contribute to power management and security architecture and design. - Work directly with third-party IP vendors to define technical requirements, evaluate IP capabilities, coordinate deliverables, and resolve issues from integration through silicon bring-up. - Work across architecture, design, verification, physical design, and software teams to define interfaces, resolve integration issues, and carry designs through pre-silicon validation and post-silicon bring-up. - Work closely with Firmware and Software teams to define boot, configuration and runtime behavior and functionality. - Build and apply automation and AI-assisted tools to accelerate design, IP integration, consistency checking, and debugging while maintaining engineering quality. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have experience in SoC architecture, RTL design, and subsystem or full-chip integration, with hands-on ownership through implementation and silicon bring-up. - Are familiar with Arm processor subsystems, including Cortex-M and Cortex-A, and AMBA protocols and interconnects such as AXI and APB. - Understand PCIe protocols and have experience configuring, integrating, and debugging controller IP. - Have experience integrating high-speed I/O, including SerDes/PHY interfaces and die-to-die links. - Have experience working directly with third-party IP vendors to evaluate technical fit, communicate requirements, and drive integration and debug issues to resolution. - Understand reset and boot architecture and the interactions between hardware, firmware, and software during initialization and recovery. - Have experience designing for debug, test, and security, and can reason about how these requirements affect the broader system. - Are comfortable writing and debugging Verilog/SystemVerilog and building scripts or tools to make integration work more efficient and reliable. - Enjoy stretching into multiple domains, learning unfamiliar parts of a system, and rolling up your sleeves to build and debug. - Enjoy working on a small, dynamic team where priorities evolve and engineers take broad ownership. - Are excited about creatively applying automation and AI tools to hardware design and integration work. items.title: Senior Product Designer, Platform
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . The Platform Design and Research team at Coinbase plays a critical role in executing on our vision to create more economic freedom for the world and sits at the center of building products across the company. We design the core platforms and internal tools that accelerate product development and operations across Coinbase, and we're building the most secure, trusted, and easy-to-use experiences for the teams that build on top of our platform. You'll join our Infra pillar, partnering closely with engineering leadership to bring design rigor to the internal tools and dashboards Coinbase teams rely on every day, from configuration and deployment tooling to observability and operational dashboards. As a Senior Product Designer, you'll independently define the problem space for these often-ambiguous, engineer-facing tools, using research and usage data to shape a roadmap that doesn't yet exist, and lead design end-to-end from discovery through launch. What you’ll do: Contribute to the overall direction and decision-making for product and design strategy across Coinbase’s infrastructure tools. Design high-quality UI and interaction patterns for data-intensive, workflow-heavy enterprise tools, including visual workflow builders, configuration management systems, and real-time dashboards. Own end-to-end design for development release-pipeline, giving engineers visibility into where their code sits on the path to production. Design the Engineering Standards Scorecard, turning 100+ standards spanning reliability, security, and paved-path adoption into a clear, trustworthy view for ICs, directors, and VPs. Run iterative design cycles: ideate, prototype, test with internal users and refine based on qualitative feedback and operational data. Partner with Eng leadership and standards owners across Coinbase orgs to define a shared service-catalog data model and ingestion approach. Required Skills and Experience: 7+ years of professional product design experience, including owning end-to-end flows from discovery through launch. Track record designing enterprise solutions for complex workflows, ideally used by both technical and non-technical users. Excellence in UX thinking, systems design, and ability to influence product strategy and roadmap in close partnership with Product and Engineering. Sharp attention to detail and mastery of your craft: visual design, interaction design, and prototyping. Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management experience. Experience designing for technical, engineer-facing, or data-heavy systems, such as internal tools, dev platforms, or governance and compliance tooling. Thrives in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment. Fluency in Figma and modern prototyping tools, including using AI tools to explore, prototype, or ship faster. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Build safety systems: Design, develop, and scale automated moderation systems, abuse detection capabilities, and guardrails for AI agents across ElevenLabs’ products. - Respond to emerging threats: Partner closely with the Investigations team to identify emerging abuse patterns, understand evolving threats, and continuously improve existing safety systems, detection mechanisms, and guardrails to address new risks. - Own production infrastructure: Build and maintain a growing ecosystem of internal safety services, taking ownership of their architecture, deployment, reliability, monitoring, and ongoing operation. - Bring ML models into production: Partner closely with ML engineers to deploy and integrate fine-tuned and proprietary ML models into production safety systems, ensuring they operate reliably and efficiently at scale. - Build end-to-end solutions: Develop backend services, APIs, internal tools, and user-facing interfaces that enable effective moderation, safety operations, and policy enforcement. - Collaborate across teams: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Safety Policy teams to translate business, regulatory, and policy requirements into scalable engineering solutions. - Product: Understand and navigate the tradeoffs between product growth, user experience, and platform safety. - Legal: Translate legal and regulatory requirements into practical, scalable safety systems. - Safety Policy: Collaborate on how safety policies are implemented technically, while helping inform policy decisions through an understanding of engineering capabilities and constraints. - Shape our technical direction: Contribute to architectural decisions and help define how our safety infrastructure evolves as our products, users, and safety challenges grow. REQUIREMENTS - 5+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems. - Strong backend engineering experience, including designing APIs, working with databases, and building scalable services. - Proficiency in Python and experience with modern backend frameworks. - Experience building and maintaining distributed systems and cloud-based applications. - Comfortable owning systems end to end, from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance. - Experience working across different parts of the stack, with the ability to build internal tools or frontend interfaces when needed. - Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to navigate ambiguous requirements and make pragmatic engineering decisions. - Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and non-technical stakeholders across different functions. BONUS - Experience building Trust & Safety, content moderation, fraud detection, or abuse prevention systems. - Experience building guardrails or safety infrastructure for AI agents and LLM-based applications. - Experience deploying and integrating ML models into production applications. - Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP). - Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana. - Experience with React or other modern frontend frameworks. - Experience with real-time data processing, event-driven architectures, or technologies such as Kafka and Redis. LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw. #LI-remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
items.location_text: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a member of the GTM team at Anthropic, you will be a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who embeds directly with our most strategic customers and leads the technical direction of their AI adoption. Customers bring you in to lead, not only to implement: you decide what should be built, and then make sure it gets built well. You will work with customer teams to ship advanced AI applications that solve real world business problems, and guide the architecture and advisory work that surrounds those builds across an account. Working closely with our Research, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll combine engineering expertise, an understanding of frontier AI applications, and customer-facing skills to understand customer workflows and develop innovative solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability. You will sit at the frontier of enterprise AI deployments and help shape our forward-deployed motion as it scales. We expect Staff FDEs to set direction under ambiguity and represent Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments. In this role, you guide architecture and build initiatives across workstreams, working directly with senior technical and business stakeholders and owning outcomes that span an account's roadmap. You don't need to have shipped agents to production. You do need deep experience building and operating production systems, hands-on time with agents, and the judgment to lead architecture and advisory work with enterprise customers. Responsibilities Own technical strategy for a key account or vertical, in partnership with account and product teams. Guide technical architecture and design decisions across multiple concurrent workstreams. Lead discovery and advisory engagements independently, shaping scope and technical strategy before a build starts. Lead engagements delivered with partners, setting the architecture and the quality bar for work you don't build yourself. Review designs and unblock other FDEs on hard technical calls. Represent Anthropic to senior technical and business stakeholders, including VPs and C-level, to align on strategy and de-risk delivery. Own your engagements end to end: scope the work, sequence it, unblock it, anticipate security and procurement gates, and deliver production systems the customer can operate. Work within customer systems to build production applications and agent components with Claude, and hand over systems the customer can run. Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams. Build long term relationships with customers and proactively identify new opportunities for AI deployment throughout the lifecycle of an engagement. Travel frequently (25%) to customer sites to build in person with customers. Be a champion for Anthropic's mission in the field. You May Be a Good Fit If You Have Deep system design and problem decomposition skills: you can walk into a discovery conversation with only a business problem and leave with a defensible technical strategy for a secure, production-ready design inside a complex enterprise environment of legacy systems, with identity and access, and compliance requirements. Experience in a senior technical, customer facing role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, or as a Tech Lead with consulting or product experience. Former technical founders are also encouraged to apply. A track record as the person a team turns to on ambiguous technical calls, whether through architecture review, pairing, or informal mentorship. A track record of directly influencing senior technical and business stakeholders, including VP and C-level, in complex organizations. Extensive experience building and operating production systems. Hands-on experience with LLMs and agents is expected. Side projects and prototypes count. Strong programming skills with proficiency in Python (and ideally in one or more additional languages like TypeScript, Java, etc), experience shipping production applications, and everyday use of AI coding tools with the judgment to review and steer. Experience leading advisory and architecture-review engagements as well as hands-on builds, and running them end to end. High agency with an ability to navigate ambiguity present in complex organizations, and the learning velocity to pick up new domains and tools fast. Passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI systems through creative technical applications. A background in financial services, healthcare/life sciences, or another enterprise vertical are nice to have. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $280,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Senior Counsel – Product (Asia-Pacific)
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Join our Regulatory Legal team, the group responsible for maintaining and growing Kraken's product offerings across every region we operate in and for advising the business on its day-to-day regulatory obligations. We are a tight, experienced group of lawyers from tradfi (traditional finance), fintech and crypto backgrounds who move fast, stay curious and take pride in the commercial accountability of our advice. We partner directly with Compliance, Product and senior leadership to keep our licensed entities running smoothly and our regulators well served. This is a remote role based in Hong Kong or Singapore, supporting our growing volume of regulatory work across the broader APAC region. You will operate as a practical legal generalist with a focus on Product legal advice: supporting launches and product changes across APAC, including derivatives and over-the-counter ("OTC") options, tokenised equities, earn and staking products, custody, and card and payments offerings. THE OPPORTUNITY - Provide product legal support for APAC launches and enablement across the entire Payward product suite, including xStocks, OTC options, institutional custody and execution, and cross-regional products rolling out across APAC - Act as a gatekeeper for new APAC outside counsel engagements: scope the work, estimate the cost, and sign off before matters are routed externally, so that outside counsel is used where local-law advice is genuinely required - Translate complex regulatory frameworks into pragmatic, actionable guidance for the business, favouring plain-English communication, measurable risk trade-offs and decision-ready recommendations - Use AI-assisted tools (for example for multi-jurisdiction licensing analysis, first drafts of regulatory submissions and matter tracking) to raise the speed and consistency of the team's work - Own the APAC regulatory workload under the direction of the APAC regulatory lead, including licence variations, client and broker agreement documentation, licensing structure questions and routine regulator correspondence - Take ownership of geography-specific licensing in markets such as Kazakhstan, Pakistan and the Philippines, instructing and supervising local counsel in region and in time zone, and supporting other APAC markets (for example South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, Vietnam, Indonesia and Malaysia) as they arise - Support Payward Group licensing initiatives in key APAC markets such as Singapore and Hong Kong, including preparing application materials and coordinating with outside counsel WHAT YOU BRING - Qualified lawyer admitted in Singapore, Hong Kong, England and Wales, or an equivalent common law jurisdiction - 10 or more years' post-qualification experience ("PQE") in financial services regulatory law, gained at a regulated financial services institution (for example a bank, broker-dealer, exchange, derivatives dealer or crypto services provider), at a law firm supporting such clients and/or at a relevant regulator - Demonstrated ability to independently own regulatory relationships and business-as-usual regulatory workstreams, including notifications, information requests and supervisory correspondence - Strong experience with the financial regulatory landscape in a major Asian financial centre (eg, Singapore and the MAS, Hong Kong and the SFC/HKMA) - Proven ability to instruct, supervise and manage the cost of local counsel across multiple jurisdictions, including in markets where you are not admitted - Working knowledge of anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing ("AML/CTF") obligations and regulatory expectations - Outstanding analytical, drafting and organisational skills, with crisp, plain-English writing - Ability to distill complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyer stakeholders - A pragmatic, commercially accountable approach to legal and regulatory risk that gives stakeholders a useful range of options and a clear recommendation - Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-moving, remote, multi-time-zone environment, owning a broad workload from day one NICE TO HAVES - Experience advising on virtual asset regulation in one or more APAC jurisdictions - Familiarity with the regulation of derivatives (including OTC options), equities and emerging tokenised financial instruments - Experience supporting change-of-control notifications or other regulatory aspects of corporate transactions - Experience with payments, e-money or card regulation - Working proficiency in a second APAC language - An authentic interest in crypto and digital assets, and familiarity with Payward's and competitors' products Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Stay connected Follow us on Twitter https://twitter.com/krakenfx Learn on the Kraken Blog https://blog.kraken.com/#:~:text=Enter%20your%20email%20address Connect on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/kraken-exchange/ Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.kraken.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice

items.title: Intern - NCAA GM
items.location_text: Jacksonville, FL, United States; Norman, OK, United States; Tampa, FL, United States
items.description: About Us Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. As we continue to scale our global platform, the Licensing Partnerships Intern will play a critical role in supporting Fanatics' college licensing agreements and partner event execution. ROLE OVERVIEW The Licensing Partnerships Intern supports the College Licensing team by tracking sales and royalty guarantees, maintaining active license records, and providing analytical insights tied to authorized direct licensees (ADLs). This role is central to planning and executing Fanatics College's annual event calendar — spanning CALS, SBJ/NFF, Tailgate, CFP, Final Four, CLC Seminar, NACDA/ICLA, and Fanatics Fest — and building the operational infrastructure that enables Partner Development and College GM teams to maximize event impact. The Licensing Partnerships Intern delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights. HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes. Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams) Collaborate cross-functionally with the Partner Development and College GM teams to ensure alignment on licensing data, event logistics, and partner-facing deliverables. Support internal stakeholders by maintaining and distributing accurate business trackers, meeting materials, and consolidated planning grids that enable the broader team to operate efficiently. Contribute to a productive debrief process following major events, helping the team capture learnings and improve execution cycles. Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans) Help deliver standout college partner experiences by supporting flawless execution of marquee events including CFP, Final Four, and Fanatics Fest — ensuring every logistical detail reflects the Fanatics brand. Maintain up-to-date records of active licenses to ensure fans and partners are always served by accurate, current agreement data. Submit new product and/or distribution channel requests that expand the reach of officially licensed college merchandise to more fans. Provide insights tied to ADL sales performance that inform how partner products are positioned and supported in the market. Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit) Build scalable planning infrastructure — including attendee and registration lists, master session schedules, available meeting windows and spaces, and team meeting grids — that transforms event execution from reactive to proactive. Identify opportunities to streamline recurring processes such as deck population, royalty tracking, and business tracker updates through smarter templates and data workflows. Bring a solutions-oriented mindset to administrative and operational challenges, proposing improvements as patterns and inefficiencies are identified. Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset) Track sales and royalty guarantees under Fanatics' college licensing agreements and deliver timely, accurate insights to the College GM team. Create and maintain deck templates for recurring partner business meetings, ensuring materials are populated with current data and ready ahead of each meeting. Manage vendor coordination, on-site materials, travel and logistics, and invite and registration lists across the full Fanatics College annual event calendar. Provide reliable administrative support across the Licensing Partnerships team, handling a broad range of tasks with attention to detail and follow-through. AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to: Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING Required Qualifications: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams — including licensing data tracking, event planning, and partner meeting preparation — simultaneously and accurately. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for tracking sales, royalty guarantees, and business metrics; comfort building and maintaining data trackers and templates. Experience or demonstrated interest in sports licensing, partnerships, or collegiate athletics business environments. items.title: Head of Legal
items.description: REMOTE | UNITED KINGDOM | CRYPTO & PAYMENTS | FCA AUTHORISATION | EMPLOYMENT OR B2B Our client is an established, profitable fintech operating at the intersection of crypto and traditional payments. It runs a consumer on/off-ramp platform and a fast-growing B2B infrastructure business: APIs and white-label solutions that let exchanges, neobanks, PSPs, wallets and other platforms embed regulated crypto and fiat services. The company is authorised under MiCA and PSD2 in the EU and is now building its regulatory presence in the UK. The culture is owner-led, high-ownership and low-bureaucracy: decisions are made quickly and close to the founders. About the role This is a senior, hands-on legal role with a single, clear mandate: own the company’s UK regulatory build. You will report directly to the CEO and be the most senior legal voice in the business on UK matters. The UK’s new cryptoasset regime takes effect in October 2027. From that date, regulated cryptoasset activity in the UK requires FCA authorisation. You will own a first-wave authorisation under this new regime end to end, alongside a UK e-money application. For a regulatory lawyer, this is a career-defining piece of work, and the window to start it is narrow. The role has no direct reports at hire. You will work closely with the company’s EU legal function. This is a deliberately focused UK mandate, not a group legal role. What you will own - FCA cryptoasset authorisation: perimeter analysis of B2C and B2B activities against the new regime, application strategy, drafting, regulatory business plan input, RFI handling and dialogue through to decision. - UK EMI application: ownership on the same basis, including sequencing between the two applications. - FCA relationship: acting as the senior in-house legal counterpart to the regulator. - UK conduct perimeter: the cryptoasset financial promotions regime, Consumer Duty, the UK Travel Rule, and safeguarding and prudential requirements. - Post-authorisation readiness: governance, senior manager and certification considerations, reporting and disclosures. - External counsel: briefing, directing and quality-controlling UK external counsel, and managing that spend. - International expansion: legal lead on additional licence applications in other jurisdictions, and advice where the UK and EU regulatory perimeters meet. - Commercial legal: drafting and negotiating English-law B2B agreements. This includes MSAs, API and white-label terms, referral and agent agreements, and banking, payment and card scheme counterparty agreements. - UK consumer-facing legal: consumer terms, financial promotions review and UK-specific disclosures. - UK employment: UK employment law and contractor arrangements, in partnership with HR. What we are looking for - Qualified solicitor or barrister in England & Wales, typically with 8+ years PQE. - Hands-on UK financial services regulatory experience, including at least one FCA authorisation or variation of permission that you personally owned or materially led, from perimeter analysis to decision. - Direct, personal interaction with the FCA: correspondence, meetings and representation that you led yourself. - Crypto or digital-asset legal experience at licensed or established firms, such as registered or authorised exchanges, regulated on/off-ramps, licensed custodians or infrastructure providers. - Cryptoasset, e-money or payments perimeter experience. Engagement with the 2025–26 FCA cryptoasset consultations is highly relevant. - Ability to draft and negotiate English-law B2B fintech agreements independently. - A track record of owning regulatory outcomes, not only advising on them. Law-firm backgrounds are welcome where this is evident. - Ability to take a clear position under pressure from senior stakeholders and counterparties, and to translate legal risk into business options with a recommendation. - Comfort operating as a remote senior with no legal support structure beneath you, working with a leadership team based outside the UK. - Practical use of AI tools in legal drafting, research or review. - Fluent legal English to regulator-facing standard. - Existing right to work in the UK, and the ability to attend regulator meetings in London as required. Team management experience is not required. We welcome strong senior counsel ready to step into a Head of Legal role. Nice to have - Previous Head of Legal, GC or senior counsel role at a UK-authorised EMI, PI or FCA-registered cryptoasset firm. - Experience of a firm moving from AML registration to full FSMA authorisation. - Involvement in industry working groups or trade association engagement on the new UK crypto regime. - SM&CR experience. - Knowledge of UK safeguarding and prudential requirements for e-money and payments. - Crown Dependency (Jersey, Guernsey, Isle of Man) or Australian regulatory exposure. - Card scheme legal experience, such as Visa/Mastercard rules and principal membership. - Experience building a legal or regulatory function in a jurisdiction from scratch. What’s on offer - A direct reporting line to the CEO and ownership of the company’s UK market entry. - A defining role in a first-wave authorisation under the UK’s new cryptoasset regime. - A remote setup in the UK, with a flat structure and fast decisions. - An employment or B2B contract, with a performance bonus linked to UK authorisation milestones. - A fast, transparent hiring process, typically completed within four weeks.

items.title: DataOps Engineer
items.description: The Wow This role is dedicated to the operational maintenance, governance, and delivery lifecycle of data assets. Unlike infrastructure-focused roles, the DataOps Engineer is responsible for user access provisioning, data platform permission management, deployment releases of analytical pipelines, and service observability (monitoring/alerting) to guarantee data availability and compliance without managing foundational cloud or network architecture. This role involves active monitoring, incident resolution, design incident prevention plan and engagement with data requests while continuously improving our data processes and systems, providing essential support that ensures optimal data quality. A taster of what you will be involved with: Access & Provisioning: Manage and audit Service Accounts, AWS IAM policies for data pipelines, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) schemas and Role & Permission management on Snowflake . Release Management: Execute and automate deployment releases for data pipeline codebases, orchestration logic and database schemas. Application Observability: Configure, monitor, and optimize pipeline alerting thresholds in Amazon CloudWatch and Coralogix to log task execution failures and data delivery delays. Application Orchestration: Manage workflows, task schedules, and environment permissions using Apache Airflow. Incident Prevention: Actively design and implement preventive operations strategies, analysing system trends, pipeline bottlenecks, and job failures to eliminate systemic risks before SLA breaches occur. Advanced Monitoring & Alerting Engineering: Formulate and maintain sophisticated observability patterns, building real-time dashboards and threshold-based notification alerts inside Coralogix to flag delays, capacity exhaustion, or anomalies. Data Integrity & First-Line Response: Perform root-cause analysis on runtime pipeline anomalies and complex data flow errors, collaborating across analytics engineering teams to design permanent, scalable operational remediation. Perform rigorous investigations into data quality, identifying discrepancies and implementing corrective actions in collaboration with other teams. Collaborate on data engineering initiatives, focusing on the enhancement of existing processes and the development of new solutions to improve overall data workflow. Engage in incident monitoring and resolution, escalating more complex issues to second line support as necessary. Resource Optimization: Monitor query runtimes and compute consumption metrics to identify underutilized resources, proposing optimizations to maintain technical excellence and cost-efficiency. Manage incidents and perform on-call duties on related Technologies required at the Role. Drive AI-powered innovation in Data Operations: Proactively identify opportunities to leverage AI, intelligent agents and automation to streamline operations, accelerate incident investigations and improve platform reliability. Experiment with emerging technologies and turn promising ideas into practical, impactful solutions. What we are looking for Must haves: Good experience configuring security structures, service integration privileges, and RBAC governance within enterprise data layers (e.g., Snowflake and AWS IAM ). Proven expertise managing, deploying workflows, and debugging task execution failures in Apache Airflow. Advanced skill in engineering cloud monitoring rules, logging metrics, and automated alert structures using Amazon CloudWatch and Coralogix. High proficiency in writing complex SQL queries for dataset analysis and metadata tracking. Strong scripting capability in Python or shell environments to automate operational checklists, administrative tasks, and compliance auditing. Nice to have: Familiarity with broader modern data environments (AWS Glue, S3, Athena and Redshift). Exposure to data observability concepts and data contract mechanisms. Good Data Analysis experience to identify trends and track Data Quality issues. Excellent verbal and written English Communication skills. Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a customer-centric mindset; ability to build positive relationships with internal clients (data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders) and translate complex technical operation issues into clear, actionable updates. Strong self-learning mindset: a highly proactive professional driven to explore new technologies, documentation, and industry best practices independently to continuously evolve their skill set. Able to set priorities, anticipate risks, and multitask under pressure. Proficiency in SQL for querying and managing datasets. Experience with scripting languages to automate and streamline tasks. Familiarity with monitoring tools and incident resolution methodologies. Reliability and strong accountability in managing data operations and supporting team objectives. A proactive approach to problem-solving with a strong attention to detail. Committed to maintaining high standards of data quality and integrity. Must hold a valid AWS Certification focused on Operations/Support (such as AWS Certified SysOps Administrator) A valid Snowflake Certification (such as Snowflake SnowPro Core Certification) to demonstrate deeply validated platform and data governance knowledge. What we offer Much like riding a rollercoaster, sometimes life at Betsson can be lightning fast with twists and turns but always FUN! Then again, what else would you expect from a business 75% millennial and 1700 strong, spread across 7 offices with 900 based out of our Malta HQ alone! We recognise it may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you’re a go-getter, initiator and adrenaline junkie, always striving to push the boundaries and challenge yourself, then you’ll fit right in. Challenge accepted? By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy

items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role This is a brand new Adoption Strategist role sitting at the intersection of adoption, enablement, scaled programs, and product expertise so we expect the scope to evolve and want someone excited to build as it does. You'll design and run the programs - onboarding tracks, lifecycle campaigns, workshops, adoption playbooks - that drive corporate and mid-market customers to activate their core use case and expand into new ones. Everything you build has to scale across a high-volume book, not be custom to one account. You'll need deep product fluency - enough to be the most credible voice in the room on how to use the product well - without ever owning an account or its technical implementation directly.
